effect.x-y: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

short_effect.x-y: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
short_effect.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.

flavor_text.x-y: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
flavor_text.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
